name: fig10-3-evolution
description: Fig 10.3 (panels e/f) — evolution reshapes the composition itself. Discrete driving events introduce variation (Variation), selection favors interfaces that sustain viability and fitness (Selection), and NEW interface capabilities arise through the ADDITION of a port (PortAddition). The environment holds several cell variants: an ancestral cell^ecoli and a derived cell^O157 that has gained an extra `new_port` (and `identity`) leaf its ancestor lacks — a new mode of interaction with the environment, not just a changed value. Evolution thus expands the space of possible organizations through new ports, couplings, and rewrites. All DRAFT processes: unit-bearing ports + behavior contracts, no dynamics (variation/port-addition described as driving-event rewrites in the contracts, not implemented).
